subject.title: fix(infra): bound stalled provider JSON/text/binary response reads with default chunk timeout

question: Should all existing JSON/text provider-helper callers inherit the new 30-second idle timeout by default?
rationale: The timeout fixes a real indefinite hang, but selecting a global default changes the runtime contract for a broad provider/plugin API surface and requires maintainer acceptance of the upgrade tradeoff.

options.title: Validate global defaults
options.body: Keep the proposed defaults after captured proof covers both a stalled response and a representative slow response that remains successful.

options.title: Use owner-specific budgets
options.body: Leave shared helpers opt-in and apply explicit idle budgets at provider operations whose expected timing is known.

recommendation.title: Validate global defaults
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed defaults after captured proof covers both a stalled response and a representative slow response that remains successful.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and co-authored the existing shared timeout contract and were explicitly routed into this PR discussion.
